title: Historical doctoral Management exam-code family and consolidation map
purpose: Correct the initial one-code-per-year PhD 2162 assumption. Track all Management-related national PhD exam sets through their historical code structure and later consolidation.
criticalFinding: A ten-year PhD Management corpus cannot be represented by one 2162 booklet per year. In 1401–1402 several Management disciplines were separate exam-set codes. In 1404–1405 many of those tracks sit under the umbrella code 2162 Management, using course-combination codes. The currently staged 2162 OCR is only one historical slice and does not establish complete Management PhD coverage.

dataModel.identityRule: Never merge question appearances solely because a discipline is renamed or moves under another exam-set code. Keep original examYear/examSetCode/booklet identity and link historical equivalence through a separate crosswalk.
dataModel.existingAuditRecordsMeaning: The existing ten doctoral records for code 2162 remain source-audit records for that code only. They are not the complete set of all PhD Management booklets for those years.

familyScope.scopeBoundary: The core Management family remains distinct from adjacent management-named examination sets. The broad audit inventory should list those adjacent series separately (e.g. Educational Management 2143 and Sports Management 2115) so a request for complete Management-related doctoral coverage can include them without corrupting the core 2162 crosswalk. Tourism 2170 and Accounting 2173 remain separately classified and are not included merely by association.

crosswalkRules: Keep historical exam-set code as an immutable source attribute.
Represent 1404/1405 combination codes as track-level exam identities inside 2162.
For 1396–1402, one discipline often equals a separate exam-set code and generally has its own question booklet and source/key.
Never map earlier 2163/2164/2165/2167/2169/2171 appearances to new 2162 solely by title; link them only through historical equivalence metadata.
Never treat the management-themed 2166 police exam or 2168 oil/gas contract exam as an ordinary public 2162 booklet.
Do not count 2170 Tourism or 2173 Accounting as Management exam-set coverage.
